reason: A bidirectional IM integration plugin that connects the DeepSeek Harness agent to Feishu and Telegram, with experimental support for additional channels, persistent conversations, streaming responses, multimedia messaging, and Feishu MCP tools that can perform external read and write operations.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 智能体接入飞书、Telegram 等即时通信渠道，提供持久会话、流式消息、多媒体收发及飞书文档、日历、任务等 MCP 工具。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness agents to Feishu, Telegram, and other IM channels with persistent sessions, streaming and multimedia messaging, and Feishu MCP tools for documents, calendars, tasks, and more.

capabilities: Connects an agent to Feishu, Telegram, and partially supported IM channels
Maintains persistent and topic-isolated conversation sessions
Sends and receives text and multimedia messages
Exposes Feishu MCP tools for messaging, documents, calendars, tasks, tables, mail, drive, wiki, and contacts
Performs external write operations such as sending messages, creating documents, calendar events, tasks, and mail
